title: WebCMS Security Hardening - Request Validation & Attack Prevention
instructions: Fix two critical errors in the KosCMS admin API: (1) ImportError for NotificationQueue class, and (2) AttributeError where dict object has no 'filter' attribute due to KosDB/SQLAlchemy interface mismatch.

1783893357.6022527.instruction: Create a NotificationQueue class in webcms/notifications/queue.py that provides the interface expected by admin_api.py. The class needs these methods: __init__(db), pending_count(), sent_count(hours), failed_count(), retrying_count(). Use the existing EmailQueue as a base or create a compatible wrapper.

log.text: Created NotificationQueue class in webcms/notifications/queue.py with all required methods: __init__(db), pending_count(), sent_count(hours), failed_count(), retrying_count(). The class handles both SQLAlchemy and KosDB backends with fallback to EmailQueue for in-memory operation.

1783893366.2778819.instruction: Add helper methods to AdminAPI class in webcms/admin/admin_api.py: _is_kosdb() to detect if self.db is KosDB client, and _get_kosdb_count(model_name) to get counts from KosDB. These helpers will be used by all query methods to handle both SQLAlchemy and KosDB backends.

log.text: Added helper methods to AdminAPI class: _is_kosdb() detects KosDB client vs SQLAlchemy session, _get_model_count() gets counts with filters, _get_model_list() gets sorted/limited lists, and _get_model_by_id() fetches single records. All helpers work with both KosDB (dict-like) and SQLAlchemy backends.

1783893366.2780678.instruction: Update the dashboard() method in webcms/admin/admin_api.py to use the KosDB helpers. The method currently uses self.db.query(User).filter(...).count() patterns which fail with KosDB. Replace with conditional logic that uses KosDB count queries when _is_kosdb() is True.

log.text: Updated dashboard() method to use _get_model_count() helper instead of direct SQLAlchemy query patterns. Now uses self._get_model_count(Model, {"is_deleted": False}) which works with both KosDB and SQLAlchemy backends.

1783893366.2793355.instruction: Update list_pages() and list_posts() methods in webcms/admin/admin_api.py to handle KosDB backend. These methods use self.db.query(Page/Post).filter(...).order_by(...).all() patterns that need KosDB-compatible alternatives.

log.text: Fixed list_pages() and list_posts() methods to use _get_model_list() helper with KosDB-compatible parameters. Also fixed list_media(), list_users(), list_roles() and all other query methods throughout admin_api.py. Rewrote entire file to fix corruption and ensure all database operations use KosDB-compatible helpers.

1783893366.2795057.instruction: Update list_users(), create_user(), update_user(), and delete_user() methods in webcms/admin/admin_api.py to handle KosDB backend. These methods use SQLAlchemy ORM patterns that fail with KosDB's dict-based interface.

1783893366.2796092.instruction: Update list_media(), list_roles(), and update_role() methods in webcms/admin/admin_api.py to handle KosDB backend compatibility.

1783893366.2797115.instruction: Update get_settings() and update_settings() methods in webcms/admin/admin_api.py to handle KosDB backend. These methods query the Setting model which needs KosDB-compatible access patterns.
